title: The Deadline of Geneva
author: Rosalind Marchetti
blurb: Isandro Fairweather, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
